main_text.l: variorum Papismi patronorum errata patefiunt: tûm inprimis Bellarmini, Gregoriiq3 de Valentia, calumniae in Calvinum ac ceteros Protestantes, argutiaeq3 pro Papisti-

page.notes: Engraving between the Scripture quotation and the imprint: a tree with a serpent coiled among the branches, two human figures beside it, and a Hebrew tetragrammaton above the tree; not transcribed as text. Handwritten annotations, not printed and therefore not transcribed: "Gene[vae]" and "vce." (or similar) beside the engraving on the left and right, "ex libris" with a name ending in "Chaponnier" (partly illegible) at the lower right, and "Wevenfel[s]t" at the foot. The title lines are in the printed capitals and italics as shown; the Q/V and superscript 3 forms of "Gregoriiq3" and "argutiaeq3" are uncertain, marked [?] in the reading sense: the superscript 3 may stand for a contraction of -que.
